title: Home
description: Luna Café: specialty coffee roasted in-house, homemade cakes and a quiet terrace.

props.title: Coffee worth *slowing down* for
props.subtitle: A small café downtown. We roast our beans **every week** and serve them with care, from morning till evening.

props.title: What you'll find here
props.subtitle: Three reasons people keep coming back.

cards.title: Specialty coffee
cards.text: Beans from small farms, roasted by us every Tuesday, so they're always fresh.

cards.title: Homemade cakes
cards.text: Carrot cake, croissants and muffins, baked right here every morning.

cards.title: A quiet terrace
cards.text: A green corner with flowers and small tables, where you can work, read or just sit in the sun.

props.alt: The café's espresso machine, with a cup under it

props.title: About us
props.text:
We started in 2019 with one espresso machine, three tables and a lot of stubbornness.

Today we have 12 seats inside, a terrace and, the neighbors say, the best carrot cake in the neighborhood. We know most of our regulars by name, and how they take their coffee.

items.title: Coffee tasting on August 28
items.text: An evening with three different beans and their stories. Seats are limited, so *write to us* and we'll save you one.

items.title: New beans from Ethiopia
items.text: This week we started roasting a new batch, with notes of jasmine and peach. Try it as a pour-over, or take a bag home: you'll find it on our [menu](/products).

items.title: Longer hours on Saturdays
items.text: We're now open until 8 pm on Saturdays. The terrace stays open as long as the weather is nice.

questions.question: Do you have plant-based milk?
questions.answer: Yes: oat, almond and soy, at no extra cost.

questions.question: Can I work from the café with my laptop?
questions.answer:
Of course. We have free Wi-Fi and outlets at most tables.

On weekends, from 10 am to 2 pm, please leave the big tables for groups.

questions.question: Do you sell beans to take home?
questions.answer: Yes, in half-pound bags. We grind them while you wait, for espresso, pour-over or a French press.

questions.question: What do I get with an account?
questions.answer: Offers just for members, like our weekend discount. The account is free, and it takes a minute to create.

props.message: We have an offer just for members. Log in to see it, or create a free account in a minute.

props.title: Members' offer: 15% off any coffee on weekends
props.text:
On Saturdays and Sundays, give us your account email at the counter and get 15% off any coffee.

Thank you for being part of Luna!
